name: Model Liability and Errors and Omissions
blurb: Cover for what a model does. Algorithmic bias class actions in hiring, lending and tenant screening, autonomous agents executing bad transactions, diagnostic AI malpractice, hallucinated professional advice, autonomous vehicle product liability, trading bot losses, industrial control misconfiguration, chatbot defamation and unauthorised commitments, coding assistant vulnerabilities, and deepfake wire fraud.

points.desc: Errors and omissions claims from biased outputs in hiring, mortgage processing, tenant screening and healthcare.
points.name: Algorithmic bias class actions

points.desc: Liability where an agent executes bad transactions, corrupts data or triggers unintended transfers.
points.name: Autonomous agent execution failures

points.desc: Claims against health systems and developers when a diagnostic tool misses a critical condition.
points.name: Diagnostic AI malpractice

points.desc: Professional liability where legal, accounting or consulting AI gives inaccurate advice.
points.name: Hallucinated professional advice

points.desc: The shift of primary collision liability from driver to software developer.
points.name: Autonomous vehicle product liability

points.desc: Cover for market losses triggered by rogue algorithmic loops.
points.name: Trading bot flash crashes

points.desc: Claims where process control AI makes improper adjustments in plants or refineries.
points.name: Industrial control misconfiguration

points.desc: Liability where a customer facing system issues unauthorised discounts or defamatory statements.
points.name: Chatbot defamation and commitments

points.desc: Exposure where generated code introduces security flaws into client software.
points.name: Coding assistant vulnerabilities

points.desc: Cyber claims where synthesised executive media induces an employee to authorise a transfer.
points.name: Deepfake wire fraud
